Children’s Activities

Morris Arboretum & Gardens

In-person events at Morris Arboretum & Gardens. Info and to register: https://www.morrisarboretum.org/see-do/events-calendar.

4 SENSE-sational Friday: Sensory Celebration; celebrate sight, smell, and touch with bright colors, great fragrances, and interesting textures; 11 a.m.

5 Magic Railway Weekend; Thomas the Tank Engine and friends run free on all the tracks; all day. Also September 6.

16 September Storytime; reading of We’re Going on a Leaf Hunt by Steve Metzger; 10:30 a.m.

Music

11 Music in the Pavilion: Duo Sapientia; in this eclectic program, Duo Sapientia (violinists Dongmyung Ahn and Mandy Wolman) seek to explore the resonances that emerge from duo violin music from two periods; 6:15 p.m.; Class of 1978 Orrery Pavilion, Van Pelt Library; register: https://libcal.library.upenn.edu/event/17306877 (Penn Libraries).
